policy: Every saved frozen Top 3 pick is reviewed regardless of confidence. Official result and process quality are separate. Disruptions are context, not automatic excuses. Historical explanations are never rewritten.
missingHistoricalPositions: Only selections actually preserved in the immutable board can be reviewed; unsaved historical Pick #2/#3 positions remain explicitly unavailable and are never reconstructed.

reviews.saferLineReview: Check only against exact frozen adjacent prices; never infer an unavailable line.
reviews.explanationReview: Original explanation unavailable; do not backfill or grade its wording.
